FN-2JYZ3SS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 311
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 311 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Transportation to adopt rules providing for applications and issuance of permits
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
